changes: Receipt now records requested close date versus effective snapshot session dates.
A snapshot without the requested date is marked STALE_SNAPSHOT.
A snapshot with the date but missing symbols is marked INCOMPLETE.
No price carry-forward or execution admission is introduced.
A snapshot without effective_session_dates is marked UNKNOWN_COVERAGE rather than guessed stale or complete.
next_acceptance: Run after the actual 2026-10-26 close with a StockDB snapshot whose effective session dates include 2026-10-26.
